rules.rationale: Macro equation defining #primeTuple as the exact tuple-expression AST containing the finite prime-length constants; it introduces syntax and no operational transition or independent mathematical fact.
Macro equation defining #emitSelected as the source-level assignment AST that appends the current word and a space to result.
Macro equation defining #maybeEmit as the source-level conditional AST using len and membership in #primeTuple.
Macro equation defining #scanBody as the exact loop-body AST for separator handling and character accumulation.
Macro equation defining #wordsBody as the complete function-body AST assembled from initialization, the loop, final emission, and return.
Macro equation defining #solutionModule as the module AST containing the words_in_sentence function with its exact parameter and #wordsBody.
Guarded simplification equation defining the true branch of the newly introduced primeLength predicate on the enumerated finite set.
Complementary guarded simplification equation defining the false branch of the newly introduced primeLength predicate outside the enumerated finite set.
Total equation defining emitWord as the accumulator update selected by primeLength; it names the mathematical summary used by the loop invariant.
Base recurrence equation defining scanOutput on an empty remaining IntSeq as the existing output accumulator.
Separator recurrence equation defining scanOutput by emitting the completed word, clearing the word accumulator, and descending on the tail.
Non-separator recurrence equation defining scanOutput by extending the current word and descending on the tail under the complementary C != 32 guard.
Base recurrence equation defining scanWord on an empty remaining IntSeq as the current word accumulator.
Separator recurrence equation defining scanWord by clearing the current word and descending on the tail.
Non-separator recurrence equation defining scanWord by appending the character and descending on the tail under C != 32.
Base recurrence equation defining scanLast on an empty remaining IntSeq as the prior character value.
Recursive equation defining scanLast by recording the head as a one-character IntSeq and descending on the tail.
Total equation defining sentenceResult as the composition of the scan summaries, final emission, and the reference strip helpers revIS and trimWS.
